rules.S_flat: rarefied hill1_cc(dc at c*_t) - hill1_cc(HF c=0) has a paraphrase-cluster bootstrap 90% CI above 0 on both tasks ('partial' if on one); c*_t must be correctness-preserving (pass >= 0.8 x pass(c=0)).
rules.S_specific: that gain exceeds each random direction's gain at c*_t (paired cluster-bootstrap 90% CI of rarefied hill1(dc) - hill1(rand_k) above 0, k=1,2), and also the placebo's when E1 ran.
rules.S_vs_prompt: dc at c*_t against enumerate and ban:X_t (efficiency = delta_hill/delta_pass_pts, CIs); 'best knob' only if the 90% CIs separate.
rules.S_commit: commitment-test verdict for the modal X on each task (intact / de-commits / commits / uninformative).
rules.PREDICT: log-score ranks and top-1 hits of the hash-committed forecasts, reported as a forecast record with no threshold.
rules.overall: ADVANCE if S_flat and S_specific hold on >= 1 task with the same sign (point estimate of delta_hill > 0) on the other; PARTIAL if S_flat holds without S_specific; DROP if S_flat fails at every correctness-preserving c of every task that has one; INCONCLUSIVE if no task has a correctness-preserving c.
rules.c_star: largest c in {0.25,0.5,1.0,1.5} plus at most one pre-registered bisection point with pass_rate(c) >= 0.8 x pass_rate(HF c=0); chosen on pass rate only, blind to diversity.

rules.move_vs_flatten: 'moves' := realised mode != X and the cluster CI of delta_hill includes 0 or lies below 0.5; 'flattens' := the CI of delta_hill lies above 0.
